messages:
jamie: Quick heads-up — found two small issues in the optimize toolkit docs while doing the migration PR.
sara: which ones?
jamie: 1) quant profile link on the migration page points to the old bucket. 2) batching example uses deprecated SDK call `redwood.optimize.batch()` instead of `client.optimize.batch()`.
alejandro: ack. Can you paste the exact links/snippet?
jamie: Link 1: https://docs.redwood.ai/old-buckets/quant-profiles.md -> should be https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/quant-profiles.md
jamie: snippet currently:
```python
# old
from redwood import optimize
optimize.batch(model="rwd-qlow", batch_size=8)
```
jamie: should be:
```python
# new
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ["REDWOOD_KEY"])
client.optimize.batch(model="rwd-qlow", batch_size=8)
```
mike: thanks — I can push a tiny PR to swap the link and update snippet. Any tests we should run?
sara: run docs CI and a quick smoke of the snippet in the examples repo. Also add a short note about KV caching behavior with short prefixes — folks keep hitting stale tokenization assumptions.
alejandro: idea: add a one-paragraph migration note that quantization profiles are now per-model and we recommend testing evals on 2-3 representative prompts before switching in prod.
jamie: yep. I'll add a small code/focus comment showing recommended profile start: 
```yaml
quant_profile: "dynamic-4bit"
notes: "start with dynamic-4bit, eval on small prompt set"
```
docs-ci: build passed for branch jamie/opt-docs-fixes :white_check_mark:
mike: I made a branch mike/docs/spotfix-quant-batch, pushed changes, opened PR #4529.
sara: assign reviewers @jamie @alejandro
jamie: added quick unit: examples/optimize/test_snippets.py — just runs the `client.optimize.batch` call against a stubbed client.
alejandro: also fixed the markdown anchor that was breaking on mobile (was `#quant-profiles` -> now `#quantization-profiles`).
mike: small nit: update the migration guide header to include a "breaking change" banner so it's more visible.
jamie: I'll add the banner and a short FAQ entry: "Will my cached prefixes break?" with answer: "No, but you may see throughput/latency variations; flush caches if moving across quant profiles or major model variants."
sara: LGTM, please include a changelog entry in docs/changelog.md and reference the PR.
mike: PR updated with changelog line.
docs-ci: docs build failed on staging — 1 broken link in optimize/tooling/kv-caching.md line 42 (old-bucket link)
jamie: fixing now, repushing.
jamie: repushed -> docs-ci: build passed
sara: cool. After merge can we backport to v1.8 branch?
mike: yes, will open backport PR after merge.
alejandro: leaving a TODO: expand examples with a short notebook showing batch size tradeoffs for 1-512 token generation lengths.
jamie: created a stub notebook in examples/notebooks/batch-tuning.ipynb (placeholder).
sara: once merged we'll announce in #eng-docs and ping customer-success for any Dedicated customers on early-access.
mike: :shipit: thanks everyone, keeping this minimal so it lands fast.
